title: 第2章 第一单，祠堂里的动静不对劲
slug: 黄牛中介没想到你请得动真神啊
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

张瑀一怔。

“道士？”

“对，道士。”三爷爷叹了口气，“咱村里那个老祠堂你知道吧？就是村东头挨着老槐树那个。”

张瑀点点头。

张家祠堂他当然知道，小时候每年过年都要跟着家里人去祠堂拜祖宗，祠堂里供着张家的历代先祖牌位，香火一直没断过。

“那祠堂最近不对劲。”三爷爷的声音更低了些，“从半个月前开始，每天晚上半夜都有动静，一会儿像是有人在里面走路，一会儿又像是有人在敲木板，咚咚咚的，瘆人得很。”

“我一开始以为是进了贼或者闹了野猫，就叫了几个后生晚上守在祠堂外头，结果你猜怎么着？”

张瑀顺着话问：“怎么着？”

“啥也没看见。”三爷爷一拍大腿，“几个后生蹲到凌晨三点，里面动静响了好几回，可他们拿着手电筒照进去，祠堂里空空荡荡的，除了牌位啥也没有。”

“门锁也好好的，没有撬过的痕迹，窗户也都关得严严实实。”

“几个后生吓得脸都白了，说啥也不肯再守了。”

三爷爷说着，又叹了口气：“我一个老头子倒是不怕，但这祠堂供的是咱张家的老祖宗，要是真有什么不干净的东西冲撞了祖宗灵位，我这管祠堂的罪过可就大了。”

“我想来想去，还是得找个有道行的道士来做个法事，看看是不是有什么说法。”

张瑀听完，心里咯噔一下。

祠堂半夜闹动静，找不到来源，几个年轻人守了一夜啥也没看见。

这事儿听着确实邪门。

但更要紧的是——就在三爷爷说完这番话的瞬间，他眼前忽然弹出了系统面板。

【检测到客户委托需求，已自动生成任务。】

【委托方：张德厚。】

【委托内容：为张家祠堂排查异常动静来源，如涉及非自然因素，需进行相应处理。】

【委托类型：镇宅/安家/驱邪。】

【建议匹配人脉：土地公公（Lv.1）。】

【任务奖励：香火值×50。】

Zhang Yu was startled.

"Taoist priest?"

"Yes, Taoist priest." Third Grandpa sighed, "You know the old ancestral hall in our village, right? It's the one at the east end of the village next to the old locust tree."

Zhang Yu nodded.

Of course he knew about the Zhang Family Ancestral Hall. When he was a child, he and his family would go to the ancestral hall to worship their ancestors every Chinese New Year.

"There's something wrong with that ancestral hall recently." Third Grandpa's voice was even lower. "Since half a month ago, there has been movement every night in the middle of the night. Sometimes it seems like someone is walking inside, and sometimes it seems like someone is knocking on the wooden board. It's a very scary sound."

"At first I thought it was a thief or a stray cat, so I asked a few young men to guard outside the ancestral hall at night. But guess what?"

Zhang Yu followed the words and asked, "What's going on?"

"I didn't see anything." Third Grandpa slapped his thigh. "A few young men squatted until three in the morning. There were sounds of movement inside several times, but when they shined their flashlights in, the ancestral hall was empty. There was nothing except the memorial tablets."

"The door lock is also in good condition, there are no signs of prying, and the windows are closed tightly."

"Several young people were so frightened that their faces turned pale, and they refused to defend themselves no matter what they said."

The third grandfather said, and then sighed: "As an old man, I am not afraid, but this ancestral hall is dedicated to the ancestors of our Zhang family. If something unclean really collides with the ancestors' spiritual throne, I, the person in charge of the ancestral hall, will be guilty."

"After much deliberation, I still have to find a Taoist priest who has the right to do a ritual to see if there is any explanation."

After Zhang Yu heard this, his heart skipped a beat.

There was a commotion in the ancestral hall in the middle of the night, but the source could not be found. Several young people kept watch all night and saw nothing.

This thing sounds really evil.

But more importantly - the moment Grandpa San finished speaking, the system panel suddenly popped up in front of him.

[Customer entrustment requirements have been detected and tasks have been automatically generated.】

[Client: Zhang Dehou.】

[Commissioned content: Investigate the source of abnormal movements in the Zhang Family Ancestral Hall. If unnatural factors are involved, they need to be dealt with accordingly.】

[Commission type: Householding/Settle-in/Exorcism.】

[Recommended matching connections: Father-in-law of the land (Lv.1).】

[Task reward: Incense value x 50.】
